items.text: If there is that which does not die, perhaps relationship with it differs from conditioned relationships. The critique of attachment may not apply to eternal objects.

provenance.exact_quote: If there is that which does not die, perhaps relationship with it differs from conditioned relationships
provenance.context: Reflecting on Jesus's claim about the Father who never dies - considering whether attachment critique applies

items.text: Contradiction held without panic — a handbook that honestly names what its authors cannot agree on has already taught the reader the most important thing: wisdom is the capacity to hold contradiction without forcing resolution.

provenance.exact_quote: Wisdom is not the absence of contradiction but the capacity to hold contradiction without panic, without forcing resolution, and without looking away.
provenance.context: Phase D closing reflection — synthesizing the entire session's disagreements into a meta-insight about wisdom itself
